title.narrative: Youth-focused policies and programs Central America 43SA

description.narrative: The UNESCO Regional Office for Central America and Colombia will strengthen youth stakeholder capacities and generate youth-led knowledge through two interconnected lines of action. First, the office will translate the UNESCO Toolbox for Youth Policy and Programming into Spanish, removing a critical access barrier for the region's governments and practitioners, and train young Spanish-speaking facilitators through a regional train-the-trainer programme, deploying the Toolbox with policy stakeholders in up to two coverage countries to support the design of evidence-based, inclusive youth policies. Second, it will implement Youth As Researchers in at least one coverage country, training young people to conduct transdisciplinary research on challenges affecting their communities and translate findings into policy-relevant knowledge products disseminated through national dialogues and CILAC channels.
